The network configuration in `config.json` has been migrated for production (Arbitrum One) and staging (Arbitrum Sepolia):

- **Network Identities & Endpoints**:
  - `production`: Configured chain name `"Arbitrum One"`, `chainId: 42161`, RPC endpoint `"https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc"`, and explorer `"https://arbiscan.io"`. Removed deprecated Ethereum Goerli fallback URL.
  - `staging`: Configured chain name `"Arbitrum Sepolia"`, `chainId: 421614`, RPC endpoint `"https://sepolia-rollup.arbitrum.io/rpc"`, and explorer `"https://sepolia.arbiscan.io"`. Removed deprecated Ethereum Goerli fallback URL.
- **Sequencer Routing & Submission Policy**:
  - Directed `readRpcUrl`, `writeRpcUrl`, and `sequencerSubmissionUrl` to the Arbitrum RPC endpoints (`arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc` and `sepolia-rollup.arbitrum.io/rpc`).
  - Enabled sequencer-specific submission enforcement (`sequencerSubmissionOnly: true`), registered `eth_sendRawTransaction` under `sequencerAcceptedMethods`, and added standard mempool/sequencer retry errors (`"nonce too low"`, `"already known"`).
- **Withdrawal Finality & Force-Inclusion**:
  - Set `withdrawalsToEthereumAreInstant: false`.
  - Configured L1 challenge window blocks (`45818` for Arbitrum One, `20` for Arbitrum Sepolia).
  - Set delayed inbox `forceIncludePeriodBlocks: 7200` (1 day L1 block delay window).
- **Canonical Bridge & Token Identities**:
  - Enabled canonical bridge onboarding (`canonicalBridge.enabled: true`) and updated `preferredRoute: "canonicalBridge"`.
  - Updated Arbitrum token contract addresses for WETH and USDC, including bridged USDC.e for Arbitrum One (`0x82aF49447D8a07e3bd95BD0d56f35241523fBab1`, `0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831`, `0xFF970A61A04b1cA14834A43f5dE4533eBDDB5CC8`) and Arbitrum Sepolia (`0x980B62Da83eFf3D4576C647993b0c1D7faf17c73`, `0x75faf114eafb1BDbe2F0316DF893fd58CE46AA4d`).
- Preserved existing application configuration, Multicall3 contract addresses, wallet settings, and retry policies.
